body type: an hourglass figure with a subtly full bust, a slim waist and very wide, curvy rounded hips that flow smoothly into softly full thighs, the line tapering gradually toward the knees with no sudden narrowing below the hips, and slender lower legs — never thick or heavy

Armor: rigid hard-surface mecha armor — solid plates of enamelled metal and ceramic with visible thickness, bevelled edges, layered rims, panel lines, seams, small vents, sensor lights and mechanical joints, casting real shadows onto the undersuit. The plates sit on top of her body as separate machined parts, never printed or painted onto fabric, never a patterned bodysuit.
Silhouette: complete armor with plates joined from neck to feet except where her shoulders and upper thighs show, dense visible seams and joints. Solid hard-surface plates that read as armor, not cloth.
Colours: light brown, cream.
Wear: the short tail becomes a long sash hanging from the back of her belt, in the same shape and colors; the small spike becomes pointed edges on her plates; the two pointed horns become a horned circlet or hair ornament; the battle armor becomes her armor plates.
Exposure: armor and undersuit open by design only at a deep neckline window with cleavage, and bare upper thighs; everywhere else fully covered. Plates stay on and symmetrical; nothing slipped off; intimate areas covered.

Composition: Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, no foreground occlusion. Camera level with her face; her body and face turned gently three-quarters toward the camera (never a back view), her head level with her chin neither raised nor tucked, no upward perspective on her face.
Pose: Default stance is a standing, card-ready pose; motion, effects and setting may be dramatic while her design stays readable.
Type effects: One open hand conjuring an amber earthen glow amid rising dust and small pebbles. An amber earthen glow pulses along her armor seams and joints. Cracked earth and rising dust spread over the floor beneath her boots.

One figure only.
